cards.verse_text: I would have sent you away with joy and singing, with tambourines and harps.
cards.snippet: I would have sent you away with joy and singing, with tambourines and harps.

cards.card_text: Then Miriam the prophetess takes a tambourine in her hand.
cards.verse_text: Then Miriam the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine in her hand, and all the women followed her with tambourines and dancing.
cards.snippet: Then Miriam the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine in her hand, and all the women followed her with tambourines and…

cards.card_text: Who follows her with tambourines and dancing?
cards.verse_text: Then Miriam the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine in her hand, and all the women followed her with tambourines and dancing.
cards.snippet: Then Miriam the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine in her hand, and all the women followed her with tambourines and…

cards.card_text: Coming out to meet Jephthah, with tambourines and dancing, is his ___.
cards.verse_text: And when Jephthah returned home to Mizpah, there was his daughter coming out to meet him with tambourines and dancing!
cards.snippet: …to Mizpah, there was his daughter coming out to meet him with tambourines and dancing!

cards.card_text: They'll have harps, tambourines, flutes AND lyres out in front, so friend, that's not a walk, that's a parade.
cards.verse_text: As you approach the city, you will meet a group of prophets coming down from the high place, preceded by harps, tambourines, flutes, and lyres, and they will be prophesying.
cards.snippet: …group of prophets coming down from the high place, preceded by harps, tambourines, flutes, and lyres, and they will be prophesying.

cards.card_text: Singing, dancing, tambourines, the WHOLE parade!
cards.verse_text: As the troops were returning home after David had killed the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel to meet King Saul with singing and dancing, with joyful songs, and with tambourines and other instruments.
cards.snippet: …meet King Saul with singing and dancing, with joyful songs, and with tambourines and other instruments.

cards.card_text: Harps, tambourines, sistrums, cymbals, the WORKS, and Mags, my little bell, would've rung the whole way.
cards.verse_text: David and all the house of Israel were celebrating before the LORD with all kinds of wood instruments, harps, stringed instruments, tambourines, sistrums, and cymbals.
cards.snippet: …before the LORD with all kinds of wood instruments, harps, stringed instruments, tambourines, sistrums, and cymbals.

cards.card_text: David and all the Israelites are celebrating before God with all their might, with songs, harps, lyres, tambourines, cymbals AND trumpets!
cards.verse_text: David and all the Israelites were celebrating before God with all their might, with songs and on harps and lyres, with tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
cards.snippet: …with all their might, with songs and on harps and lyres, with tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.

cards.card_text: Singers up front, musicians right behind, with maidens playing tambourines all around.
cards.verse_text: The singers lead the way, the musicians follow after, among the maidens playing tambourines.
cards.snippet: …singers lead the way, the musicians follow after, among the maidens playing tambourines.

cards.card_text: And he wants the WHOLE band: a song, the tambourine, the harp and the lyre.
cards.verse_text: Lift up a song, strike the tambourine, play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre.
cards.snippet: Lift up a song, strike the tambourine, play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre.

cards.card_text: And they make music to Him with tambourine and harp.
cards.verse_text: Let them praise His name with dancing, and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.
cards.snippet: …them praise His name with dancing, and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.

cards.card_text: After the horn, harp and lyre, Psalm 150 pairs the tambourine with something that isn't an instrument at all.
cards.verse_text: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute.
cards.snippet: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute.

cards.card_text: Tambourine AND dancing, then strings and flute.
cards.verse_text: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute.
cards.snippet: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute.

cards.card_text: Their feasts come with lyre and harp, tambourines and flutes and wine.
cards.verse_text: At their feasts are the lyre and harp, tambourines and flutes and wine.
cards.snippet: At their feasts are the lyre and harp, tambourines and flutes and wine.

cards.card_text: Tambourines, revelers, harp: all gone quiet, and friend, I KNOW that kind of quiet.
cards.verse_text: The joyful tambourines have ceased; the noise of revelers has stopped; the joyful harp is silent.
cards.snippet: The joyful tambourines have ceased; the noise of revelers has stopped; the joyful harp is…

cards.card_text: With every stroke of the LORD's rod on Assyria, tambourines and lyres will sound.
cards.verse_text: And with every stroke of the rod of punishment that the LORD brings down on them, the tambourines and lyres will sound as He battles with weapons brandished.
cards.snippet: …the rod of punishment that the LORD brings down on them, the tambourines and lyres will sound as He battles with weapons brandished.

cards.card_text: God says Virgin Israel will take up her tambourines again.
cards.verse_text: Again you will take up your tambourines and go out in joyful dancing.
cards.snippet: Again you will take up your tambourines and go out in joyful dancing.
